On 17.4.2021, the petitioners-accused herein along with accused No.1 came to the house of the deceased and picked up the quarrel and accused No.1 took all clothes belonging to her and threatened the deceased that she would file cases against him and his family members and send them to Jail.
On 19.04.2021, at about 8.00 pm the 2nd respondent was informed that her son has committed suicide by hanging.
The Registration of FIR is impugned in this petition.
4. Heard the learned counsel for the parties.

5. The only allegation against these petitioners is that they accompanied the accused No.1 to the house of the deceased and were present when the accused No.1 threatened the deceased that she would register more cases and she would send the deceased and his family members to Jail.

The Hon'ble Apex Court in catena of decisions has held that, to constitute an offence punishable under Section 306 of IPC, the following essential elements must be satisfied:
i) There must be an intention on the part of the accused to aid or instigate or abet the deceased to commit suicide.
ii) There must be a suicidal death and abetment thereof.
iii) There must a continuous harassment meted out by the accused before the death.
iv) Such irritation or annoying must be proximate to the time of occurrence of death.
7.

The Hon'ble Supreme Court in the case of Geo Varghese -vs- State of Rajasthan and another (2021 SCC OnLine SC 873) at para-23 has held as follows:
"23.

entities.text: Geo Varghese -vs- State of Rajasthan and another (2021 SCC OnLine SC 873)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: What is required to constitute an alleged abetment of suicide under Section 306 IPC is there must be an allegation of either direct or indirect act of incitement to the commission of offence of suicide and mere allegations of harassment of the deceased by another person would not be sufficient in itself, unless, there are allegations of such actions on the part of the accused which compelled the commission of suicide.

Further if the person committing suicide is hypersensitive and the allegations attributed to the accused is otherwise not ordinarily expected to induce a similarly situated persons to take the extreme step of committing suicide, it would be unsafe to hold the accused guilty of abetment of suicide.

Thus, what is required is an examination of every case on its NC: 2023:KHC:28806 own facts and circumstances and keeping in consideration the surrounding circumstances as well, which may have bearing on the alleged action of the accused and the psyche of the deceased."

Therefore,
the continuation of the investigation against these petitioners will be an abuse of process of law.

Accordingly, I pass the following:
ORDER i) The criminal petition is allowed;
ii) The impugned FIR in Crime No.143/2021 registered by the Attibele Police Station insofar as it relates to accused Nos.2 to 5 is hereby quashed.
